Baby Status keeps everything on this phone. What it stores. Your baby's name, birth date and photo, and the feeds, diaper changes, measurements and pumping sessions you log, and Mom's name. Nothing else. Where it lives. In the app's private storage on this device. The app has no account, no server, no analytics and no ads, and it doesn't use the internet. Backups. If Android backup is turned on for this phone, Android includes the app's data in your Google backup so it can come back on a new phone. You control this in your phone's backup settings. Deleting it. Uninstalling the app, or clearing its storage, deletes all of it.
